_comment: Two interpolation surfaces live in this file. (1) Generator-time: tokens like Money Ledger are uppercase-snake-case placeholders replaced by `template-manager generate` before the scenario is built — they appear as literal display values at runtime. (2) Runtime: tokens like {{count}} are i18next interpolation, replaced by `t(key, { count })` at render time. Keys that start with an underscore (like this one) are sentinels — skipped by the codegen, parity test, and unused-key audit.

app.title: Money Ledger
app.description: A read-time, append-only view of where money is and where it went.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Runway, source completeness, and declared goals from the journal.
dashboard.emptyGuidance: Create a book and choose its book_id before recording the first event. No zero is implied.
dashboard.goalsDescription: Declared thresholds with their sustain-window progress.
dashboard.changeDescription: Read-time figures; no balance is stored.
dashboard.requestError: The goal could not be saved. Check the request and try again.
dashboard.trendDescription: Inflow, outflow, and net movement from the Money Ledger journal.
dashboard.trendEmpty: No postings exist in this window, so the trend is undefined rather than zero.
dashboard.trendGap: Gap: {{reason}}. The interval is not plotted or interpolated.

journal.title: Journal
journal.description: Events show their adapter, basis, and provenance. Corrections are reversing entries.
journal.eventSource: Source and fetch age are visible beside the event.
journal.reversalReason: A reversal always carries a reason.
journal.manualEntry: Record an event through the ordinary manual adapter.
journal.duplicateNotice: This external event was already recorded; no second posting was created.
journal.validationError: Complete every required field before recording the event.
journal.requestError: The write could not be completed. Check the request and try again.
journal.reversalDialogDescription: Reversal creates a linked, append-only posting. The original is never edited or deleted.
journal.emptyGuidance: Record an event by hand or run an adapter to begin.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Create a book and its accounts before recording money events.
accounts.balanceBasis: Balances are computed from postings at read time.
accounts.balanceGap: An unavailable source is shown as a gap, never as zero.
accounts.transferPair: Inter-book movement is represented by paired postings.
accounts.validationError: Complete every required field before saving.
accounts.requestError: The write could not be completed. Check the request and try again.
accounts.emptyGuidance: Create the first book and account to begin.

adapters.title: Adapters
adapters.description: Manual entry and file import use the same typed money-event contract.
adapters.manualAdapter: Manual entry is an ordinary adapter.
adapters.failureReason: Failure reason is shown to the operator.
adapters.credentialGap: Credentials are never stored in the journal.
adapters.emptyGuidance: Register an adapter to admit the first event.
adapters.requestError: The adapter operation could not be completed.

statements.title: Statements
statements.description: Income, expense, assets, and liabilities are computed from the journal.
statements.coverageNote: Coverage and source age accompany the figures.
statements.categoryBreakdown: Category breakdown is descriptive, not tax advice.
statements.uncategorisedNotReported: Uncategorised count is not reported by this statement response.
statements.notTaxAdvice: This statement is not tax advice.
statements.emptyGuidance: Record postings before requesting a statement.

settings.title: Settings
settings.goalDescription: Declared goals show threshold, comparison, sustain window, and buffer.

health.title: API Health
health.error: Unable to reach the API. Make sure the scenario is running through `vrooli scenario start`.

errors.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.message: An unexpected error occurred while rendering the page. Try again, or reload if the problem persists.
